bzip3.notes: Uses bundled bzip3 library by default

glfw.notes: Can auto-build GLFW if not found in system

mysqlnd_ed25519.notes: MariaDB ed25519 authentication plugin for mysqlnd

mysqlnd_parsec.notes: MariaDB PARSEC authentication plugin for mysqlnd

oci8.notes: Requires Oracle Instant Client or ORACLE_HOME (not auto-installed)

oqs.notes: Requires liboqs >= 0.14.0 (post-quantum cryptography library) - user must install

pdo_oci.notes: PDO driver for Oracle - requires Oracle Instant Client or ORACLE_HOME (not auto-installed)

pg_query.notes: Auto-downloads and builds libpg_query during build

snappy.notes: Uses bundled snappy library by default

solr.notes: Apache Solr client - requires libcurl >= 7.15.5, libxml2, and json extension
